metamorphic_relations.name: Corpse or object floats in mid-air
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a dead body, creature corpse, or object suspended in mid-air or slowly drifting sideways through the air with nothing holding it up?

metamorphic_relations.name: Player or NPC model invisible but shadow visible
metamorphic_relations.check: Is the player character's body completely invisible yet a human-shaped shadow is clearly visible on the ground moving with the camera?

metamorphic_relations.name: Dead body twitches or dances on ground
metamorphic_relations.check: Does a dead NPC or creature continue to twitch, shake, jerk, or perform rhythmic bouncing movements on the ground after being killed?

metamorphic_relations.name: NPC body incomplete or jittering between positions
metamorphic_relations.check: Does an NPC appear with a partially broken, stretched, or incomplete character model while also rapidly jittering or snapping between different positions?

metamorphic_relations.name: Object moves on its own without force
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a prop (trash can, barrel, crate) rolling, sliding, spinning, or tumbling across a surface with no character, explosion, or visible force acting on it?

metamorphic_relations.name: NPC moves at extreme speed or teleports
metamorphic_relations.check: Does an NPC or creature move between positions so fast that it appears to teleport, skipping all intermediate positions?

metamorphic_relations.name: NPC walks in place or barely moves forward
metamorphic_relations.check: Is an NPC playing a full walking or running leg animation but their body is not actually moving forward?

metamorphic_relations.name: Player clips through wall or falls below map
metamorphic_relations.check: Does the player character pass through a solid wall, floor, or terrain surface and fall into the void beneath the game world?

metamorphic_relations.name: Corpse launched to unreachable location
metamorphic_relations.check: After dying, is an NPC's body launched with excessive upward force, rocketing into the sky or landing on a physically implausible elevated surface?

metamorphic_relations.name: NPC despawns visibly during interaction
metamorphic_relations.check: Does an NPC abruptly vanish while the player is looking directly at them or talking to them?

metamorphic_relations.name: NPC invulnerable or ignores lethal damage
metamorphic_relations.check: Does an NPC continue standing and behaving normally after receiving clearly lethal damage without dying, staggering, or showing any damage response?

metamorphic_relations.name: NPC body parts misaligned during seated animation
metamorphic_relations.check: While an NPC is seated and performing an activity, does their upper body visibly slide or shift to a different position while their lower body remains fixed?

metamorphic_relations.name: Downed enemy slides across ground while attacking
metamorphic_relations.check: Does a creature lying flat on the ground slide horizontally across the floor while still performing melee attack swings, without ever standing up? The enemy is ALIVE and ATTACKING while sliding.

metamorphic_relations.name: Dead NPC teleports and re-animates
metamorphic_relations.check: After being killed, does an NPC's body suddenly relocate to a completely different position and resume walking or idle animations before collapsing again?
